channel.description: Recent content in Italian Coffee on Barista At Home

item.title: Bicerin: Turin's 300-Year-Old Espresso, Chocolate & Cream Drink (Recipe & Guide)
item.description: How to make a real Turin Bicerin: layered espresso, hot drinking chocolate, and barely-whipped cream in a tall glass. Authentic recipe, history (Caffè Al Bicerin, 1763), Bicerin vs Mocha vs Marocchino, and 6 variations.

item.title: Marocchino: The Italian Espresso, Cocoa & Milk Layered Drink (Recipe & Guide)
item.description: How to make an authentic Italian Marocchino: cocoa-dusted glass, espresso, and a layer of frothed milk in a 3 oz tumbler. Origin, vs Mocha vs Bicerin, recipe with photos, and 7 variations.

item.title: Caffè Shakerato Recipe: Italian Iced Espresso, Shaken Not Stirred
item.description: How to make a caffè shakerato at home: the frothy Italian iced espresso shaken in a cocktail shaker. Classic recipe, 5 variations, and everything that makes it different from iced espresso.
